why: Multiple sources (arXiv, Annals of Mathematics, Quanta Magazine) report that Marc Cabanes and Britta Späth proved the McKay conjecture in full generality for all primes and all finite groups, with the manuscript posted to arXiv in October 2024 and the paper accepted at Annals of Mathematics in April 2025.
